From Kiss · Price: a sticker your stand must place by touch; the damage only comes when it's removed.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: stick on an object to split it into two; removing the sticker slams them back together.
  • 5: Surge: stick on a creature that your stand hits; it gains a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} duplicate body. Removing it (1 action, or at your next turn) deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage, no save.
  • 9: Two stickers.
  • 13: Split a creature's weapon.
  • 17: Duplicate yourself: a copy gives you one extra Stride per round.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
